result_summary.title: Audit log gaps and data residency concerns
result_summary.description: We are seeing some discrepancies in our production audit logs in the US-West region. It looks like entries are missing, and there might be an issue with the data residency flag. This is a critical compliance concern for us involving nearly 3000 users. The logs just don't seem complete. Please escalate this to security/compliance immediately as we are worried about missing records.
